_comment: Manual injury / availability overrides. The model removes or reduces a player's contribution based on this file, on top of auto-detection from recent game participation. Match by CFBD athlete 'id' (most reliable) OR by 'name' + 'team'. status 'out' removes the player's value; 'limited' (or 'questionable'/'doubtful') halves it. Changes take effect the next time you click 'Update data' (or restart the app).
